title: AR69004: Planning Workshop
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Integrated plan for urban region, including two weeks field survey.
Theories and principles of urban development plan and preparation for survey
and data collection.
Field survey of the study area.
Analyses of data and information;
Planning for urban area and its region (structure plan / development plan) with
emphasis on: a) Land use and transportation network, b) Infrastructure plan, c)
Action area programs and urban renewal plan, d) Capital budget and financing,
e) Administrative and management backup for plan implementation.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper

Classroom resources
